# Section 040: Continuous Integration Pipelines (Tekton, Argo Workflows and Events)

A GitOps controller only delivers what lands in Git. This section teaches Tekton, a CI system that runs each step as a container in a pod, and ends with the hand-off where a pipeline pushes a new image tag and commits it to the GitOps repository that Argo CD watches. It comes after the delivery sections because the hand-off needs an Application to deliver the result.

**Curriculum item covered:** Building and Configuring CI/CD Pipelines Integrated with Kubernetes

---

## What You Will Master

- Write a Task with params, steps, results and a workspace
- Chain Tasks in a Pipeline with runAfter and pass a result from one Task to the next
- Start a PipelineRun with a PersistentVolumeClaim workspace and read its logs with tkn
- Reference a shared Task through the cluster or git resolver instead of copying it
- Diagnose a failed TaskRun from its step status and the pod logs
- Run a Task in parallel with another and pass it a result and a param
- Start a Pipeline several times with tkn and different param values, save a run log to a file and delete a failed run
- Give a Pipeline that changes the cluster the right ServiceAccount and RBAC rights
- Push a newly tagged image to the in-cluster registry from a pipeline Task
- Update the image tag in a GitOps repository from a pipeline with a Git commit
- Give a Task Git credentials through a Secret and a service account
- Start a PipelineRun from a Git push with an EventListener, a TriggerBinding and a TriggerTemplate
- Prove the full flow from a push to a PipelineRun, a commit and an Argo CD sync of the new version

---

## The Learning Path

The section has the modules below, in reading order. Each module has a playground for practice, and the section ends with a capstone challenge.

### 1. Build Tekton Tasks And Pipelines
*   **Module Reader:** Build Tekton Tasks And Pipelines
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-040/module-01/playground` — kind cluster with Tekton Pipelines 1.17.0, the tkn CLI 0.46.1 and Gitea with repository `starfleet/scout-app` (a small source tree with a Makefile-style test script). A Task `run-tests` is installed and deliberately has a step that fails on a wrong working directory. Deliberately absent: no Pipeline, no Triggers, no registry.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-040/module-01/playground
    ```
*   **tkn and cluster access lab:** Run A Pipeline That Changes The Cluster With tkn — `sections/section-040/module-01/labs/lab-02`. Read a failed run, add a Task that runs in parallel with another, extend a ClusterRole, start the Pipeline for two sites with `tkn` and the right ServiceAccount, save one log to a file, and delete the failed run.

### 2. Hand Off From A Tekton Pipeline To GitOps
*   **Module Reader:** Hand Off From A Tekton Pipeline To GitOps
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-040/module-02/playground` — kind cluster with Tekton Pipelines 1.17.0 and Triggers 0.36.4, an in-cluster OCI registry, Gitea with `starfleet/scout-app` and `starfleet/scout-deploy`, and Argo CD 3.5.4 with an Application `scout` that auto-syncs `scout-deploy` into `starfleet`. Deliberately absent: no Gitea webhook, no EventListener and no Git credential Secret for the pipeline.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-040/module-02/playground
    ```

### 3. Run CI Workflows With Argo Workflows
*   **Module Reader:** Run CI Workflows With Argo Workflows
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-040/module-03/playground` — kind cluster with Argo Workflows v4.1.6 and the `argo` command-line tool, Argo Events v1.9.11 with a one-pod EventBus, and Gitea with `starfleet/scout-app`. A WorkflowTemplate `run-tests` is installed and deliberately has a step with a wrong working directory. Deliberately absent: no Workflow, no EventSource and no Sensor.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-040/module-03/playground
    ```
*   **Argo command-line lab:** Run And Repair Workflows With The argo Command-Line Tool — `sections/section-040/module-03/labs/lab-02`. Read a failed run, fix its WorkflowTemplate, run a copied step in parallel, start a second template with a namespace parameter and a ServiceAccount, and keep one successful run per template.

### Section Capstone Challenge
*   **Comprehensive Challenge:** Continuous Integration Pipelines With Tekton Capstone — `sections/section-040/capstone/labs/lab-01`
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-040/capstone/labs/lab-01
    astrona submit -c .
    ```
*   **Hands-on Objective:** Repair a CI pipeline for `scout` that fails at its test step and cannot push its GitOps commit, then wire a Gitea webhook so a push to `scout-app` starts it, proving one push ends with the new version serving traffic in `starfleet` through Argo CD.
